$comment: P69 (lane lm, D-LK-PE-DLL-EXPORTS-THE-SHIPPED-RUNTIME-IT-LINKS): a shared library EXPORTS ITS OWN API, never the shipped-runtime bodies it links to implement it. Each arm's `dependsOn` builds dsslib.c — one function, lib_entry, calling memalignment (DSS's runtime body on every format), strfromd and snprintf (DSS's C23 entry points on pe and Mach-O) — into the target's shared library; main.c then reads that library's FILE (it never loads it: the executable records no dependency on it — ✔MEASURED 2026-10-01 with the lane's dsscp, the ELF executable's DT_NEEDED names libc.so.6 alone and the Mach-O executable's LC_LOAD_DYLIB /usr/lib/libSystem.B.dylib alone — so the Mach-O arms run with no loader search path) and counts its exports by the format's own magic: ELF .dynsym entries that are defined, GLOBAL or WEAK and DEFAULT or PROTECTED; Mach-O symbol-table entries that are N_SECT, N_EXT and not N_PEXT; pe export-directory names. It also proves the runtime is INSIDE the image (ELF: .symtab defines memalignment while .dynsym does not name it; Mach-O: _memalignment is a defined, non-exported symbol; pe: no import names memalignment) — without that half, a library that never linked the runtime would export lib_entry alone too, and the count would pass vacuously. Exit 42 iff the one export is lib_entry and the runtime is inside. ✔MEASURED references: gcc 13.3.0 and clang 18.1.3 `-shared` export lib_entry alone (nm -D --defined-only, probe-reference-cc run 20261001-045157-a7ec61fb), Apple clang 21 `-dynamiclib` _lib_entry alone on both arches (nm -gU, run 20261001-045943-1ce3d762). The mechanism: the nested build that materialises a shipped runtime archive declares its definitions hidden, once, as libgcc.a's members are (Program::setArchiveDefinitionVisibility in resolveShippedRuntimeArchives), and every image export gate already leaves a hidden definition out. On pe the declaration rides the COFF MEMBER: a COFF symbol has no visibility field, so DSS's COFF writer states each hidden external definition as a `.drectve` `-exclude-symbols:<name>` directive beside the ordinary external symbol — the ecosystem's spelling (✔MEASURED, clang 18.1.3 for x86_64-w64-windows-gnu, run 20261001-152320-120ebcb3; mingw-w64 gcc 13.2.0 ignores the attribute with a warning, run 20261001-152413-a2378443) — and the COFF reader lifts it back to hidden, so the DLL's export directory, which already reads the visibility, leaves the runtime out; before that pair the DLL exported 31 names (✔MEASURED 2026-10-01: the 14 `__dss_isoc23_*` entry points, 10 `__dss_platform_*` hooks, free_aligned_sized, free_sized, memalignment, strfromd/f/l and lib_entry). The release arm differs from the baseline in EVERY image it builds — each library and each executable, on all five pairs (✔MEASURED 2026-10-01 with the lane's dsscp) — so both levels carry `mustDifferFromBaseline`.
